graph.title: LEGO Mixels 41500 Flain
notes: The booklet pictures are low resolution and several steps have no parts box (the pyramid in body step 6, the row of studs in head step 8, and the front sub-assembly on page 15). Part-to-step assignments were inferred from the parts list counts, so some stud and anti-stud pairings are best guesses.

Body: I read page 2 step 2 as two light-grey 14704 plates on the red 2x2 plate. Their side sockets take the foot ball joints. I assumed the 3004 brick, the 3039 slope and the black bracket sit on those plates.
The two 2540 handles are assumed to clip into the arm clips. The two 3048c slopes are assumed to form the pyramid. The 3937 hinge brick and the 6134 hinge plate carry the head.
Head: the five 3794b jumpers, the extra 3023 plates and the 3022 plate are placed by count. The second 61252 clip (for the second large flame) is assumed hidden behind the head in step 7.
The eyes (32474) are assumed to push onto studs, using their axle-hole.
The head attaches to the body through the 6134 hinge plate studs, as in the final picture.
The flame pieces are placed by the final pictures: large flames on the clips, small flames on jumper studs.
Feet, arms and curved crown pieces are repeats. Their copies attach to different external endpoints through attach overrides.
